title: ROUNDDOWN ( -1.9, 0 ) is -1: down means toward zero

source.quote: Rounds a number down, toward zero.
source.supports: ROUNDDOWN rounds toward zero, so a negative number moves up

derivation: -1.9 rounded toward zero to 0 digits is -1 (INT ( -1.9 ) would be -2). ROUNDDOWN returns a decimal number: -1.0.
